notes.title: Reminder: Spark TEJ 3 has been out on the nintendo switch and...
notes.notes:
You saw the title and the thumbnail, you know what this is. But in case you missed it, Spark the Electric Jester 3 has released on Nintendo Switch a while ago and I thought it would be nice to remind you guys its been out there in case you missed it.

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/spark-the-electric-jester-3-switch/]<Link>[/url]

And with that I can also officially announce Spark TEJ 3 is coming to the [b]XBOX SERIES[/b] and [b]PS5[/b]
When? That's still to be determined but it might be a while. Those ports are being handled by [url=https://x.com/FreakZoneGames]@FreakZoneGames[/url], Same as the switch version.

notes.title: Wind Jester Spark Plushie Announcement and Release!
notes.notes:
Follow the link here: [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/the-wind-jester-plush]https://www.makeship.com/products/the-wind-jester-plush[/url]

Its the wind jester! From Spark TEJ 1, but in the style of Spark TEJ 3.
While the wind jester was not present in the third game, this plushie is a cannon look into how the wind jester would look like in Spark TEJ 3.

Its only available for a limited time before its gone forever, so get it before it is gone!
